topic: Examen du Premier Trimestre (First Term Examination)

subUnits.title: 12.1 Section A — Questions Objectives (Answer All 30)
notes: Section A — Objective Questions
Instructions: Answer ALL thirty questions. Recommended time: 45 minutes for Section A.
Section A covers ALL topics from this term:
- Professions: naming, être + profession (no article), feminine forms, functions
- Qualities and sentiment verbs: admirable/detestable vocabulary, aimer/adorer/admirer/détester
- Illnesses: names + gender, avoir mal à + body part contractions
- Causes of illness: causer + cause-effect pairs
- Affected populations: vocabulary + surtout/souvent
- Hygiene: actions, benefits chain
Exam Strategy:
- Read ALL four options before choosing your answer.
- For grammar questions, apply the rule before looking at the options.
- Eliminate obviously wrong options first.
- If unsure between two, recall the analogy or formula from your notes.

quiz.explanation: 'Le médecin' means the doctor.

quiz.q: How would you say 'she is a doctor'?
quiz.explanation: 'Elle est médecin' — être + profession, no article. 'Médecin' is also invariable (same for m/f).
'Le journaliste écrit des articles' — the journalist writes articles.
'Adorable' means adorable — an unchanging adjective (already ends in '-e').

quiz.q: What is the correct conjugation of 'admirer' for 'je' (I)?
quiz.explanation: 'J'admire' — regular -ER pattern, first-person singular.

quiz.q: How would you say 'I admire my mother's kindness'?
opts: J'admire de la gentillesse ma mère
J'admire la gentillesse de ma mère
J'aime la gentillesse de ma mère seulement
quiz.explanation: Correct structure: j'admire + la [quality] + de [person] → 'j'admire la gentillesse de ma mère.'
'Ennuyeux(se)' means boring — feminine: ennuyeuse.

quiz.q: When describing 'les gens' (people) with an adjective, the adjective must be ___.
quiz.explanation: 'Les gens' is plural → the adjective must also be plural: les gens malhonnêtes (not malhonnête).
'La fièvre jaune' means yellow fever — a feminine noun.

quiz.q: What is the grammatical gender of 'le paludisme'?
quiz.explanation: 'Le paludisme' is masculine — indicated by the article 'le.'

quiz.q: How would you say 'my arm hurts'?
quiz.explanation: 'Le bras' is masculine singular: à + le → au. Correct: 'j'ai mal au bras.'

quiz.q: How would you say 'my teeth hurt'?
quiz.explanation: 'Les dents' is plural: à + les → aux. Correct: 'j'ai mal aux dents.'

quiz.q: Is 'à le' ever correct in standard French?
opts: Yes, but only in formal writing
Yes, but only when speaking quickly
Yes, it is always correct as written
No, it must always contract to 'au'
quiz.explanation: 'À le' NEVER appears in correct French — it always contracts to 'au.' This rule has no exceptions.
'La nourriture gâtée cause la diarrhée et la dysenterie' — spoiled food causes diarrhoea and dysentery.
'Trop de travail cause la fatigue' — too much work causes fatigue.
'Les pauvres' means the poor.
'Souvent' means often — used to express frequency without making an absolute claim.

quiz.q: Which population group might be described as vulnerable to waterborne illnesses due to limited access to resources?
opts: tout le monde equally, with no distinction
no group is more vulnerable than another
quiz.explanation: 'Les pauvres' often have less access to clean water, making them more vulnerable to waterborne illnesses like cholera.
'Éviter les maladies' means to avoid illnesses — the goal of good hygiene.

quiz.q: What does 'faire cuire la nourriture' mean?
quiz.explanation: 'Faire cuire la nourriture' means to cook food thoroughly — an essential hygiene action to prevent food-borne illness.
'Développement rapide' means rapid development — one of the wider benefits of a healthy, hygienic population.
'L'avocat(e)' means the lawyer — feminine adds -e: avocate.
'Soigner' means to care for or treat — used in 'l'infirmier(ère) soigne les malades.'
'Magnifique' means magnificent — an unchanging adjective (same form for masculine and feminine).
'Antipathique' means unlikeable — an unchanging adjective.
'La dysenterie' means dysentery — a feminine noun.

quiz.q: Does 'à + la' contract into a different form?
quiz.explanation: 'À + la' does NOT contract — it stays as 'à la.' Only masculine singular and plural forms contract.

quiz.q: What causes the flu, according to this term's vocabulary?
quiz.explanation: 'Le froid cause la grippe' — cold weather causes flu.
'Les jeunes' means young people.
'Protéger la famille' means to protect the family — one of the motivations and benefits of good hygiene.

subUnits.title: 12.2 Section B — Questions de Théorie
notes: Section B — Theory / Essay Questions
Instructions: Answer ALL FIVE questions in complete French sentences. Show all your working and reasoning — method marks are awarded even when the final answer has a minor error.
Questions:
1. Nommez CINQ professions en français avec l'article correct, et donnez la forme féminine de DEUX d'entre elles.
2. Conjuguez 'adorer' ET 'admirer' au présent avec 'je,' 'nous,' et 'ils/elles.'
3. Nommez les cinq maladies apprises ce trimestre avec leur article correct, et expliquez les règles de contraction pour 'avoir mal à.'
4. Traduisez: 'Mosquitoes cause malaria. This illness especially affects children and the poor.'
5. Rédaction: rédigez un paragraphe (5 phrases minimum) sur UNE maladie de votre choix, incluant son nom, sa cause, les populations affectées, ET un conseil d'hygiène pour l'éviter.
